text: The migration keeps #filter flex sizing and its text-width override in the shared preference stylesheet, removes the duplicate password stylesheet rule and replaces a broad margin reset with an 8 px logical start margin under #CookiesDialog. The actual Cookies root has that id, its label targets filter, and its search input controls cookiesList. The fixed comparison retains the local margin. These are source and control-association facts; no measured gap, focus behavior or rendered accessibility result is established.
title: The shared search-field spacing rule is scoped to the Cookies dialog
